  <entry>
    <title>IOOS Regional Association processed asset inventory since 2019-01-01.</title>
    <link href="https://erddap.ioos.us/erddap/tabledap/processed_asset_inventory.html"/>
    <id>https://erddap.ioos.us/erddap/tabledap/processed_asset_inventory.html</id>
    <updated>2026-11-23T16:41:24Z</updated>
    <content type="text">
The Observing Asset Inventory requirements can be found on the bottom of page 4 of the Cooperative Agreement Progress Report Guidance document. The inventories cover the entire calendar year (CY), for the year they are reporting (eg. for 2020 the period of time is Jan 1 2020 - Dec 31 2020).

cdm_data_type = Other
VARIABLES:
Year (Year of the inventory in YYYY format)
RA
latitude (degrees_north)
longitude (degrees_east)
station_long_name
Platform
Operational
station_deployment
RA_Funded
Water_temp
Salinity
Wtr_press
Dew_pt
Rel_hum
Air_temp
Winds
Air_press
Precip (Precipitation)
Solar_radn
Visibility
Water_level
Waves
Currents
Turbidity
DO
... (12 more variables)
    </content>
  </entry>
  <entry>
    <title>IOOS By The Numbers</title>
    <link href="https://erddap.ioos.us/erddap/tabledap/by_the_numbers.html"/>
    <id>https://erddap.ioos.us/erddap/tabledap/by_the_numbers.html</id>
    <updated>2026-11-18T18:25:57Z</updated>
    <content type="text">
U.S. IOOS® is a vital tool for tracking, predicting, managing, and adapting to changes in our ocean, coastal and Great Lakes environment.  "IOOS by the Numbers" is was developed as a graphical representation of IOOS  -- a system of includes our partnerships, research and observing components, and data management capabilities. This figure is an annually updated collection of numbers that show the breadth of the IOOS Program as it is growing and evolving.  These data were obtained from multiple sources in July 2022. The original source for each value is identified below. Links to each federal partner or regional association are provided.

cdm_data_type = Other
VARIABLES:
time (Date UTC, seconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z)
Federal_Partners (count)
Regional_Associations (count)
HF_Radar_Stations (count)
NGDAC_Glider_Days (count)
National_Platforms (count)
Regional_Platforms (count)
ATN_Deployments (count)
MBON_Projects (count)
OTT_Projects (count)
HAB_Pilot_Projects (count)
QARTOD_Manuals (count)
IOOS_Core_Variables (count)
Metadata_Records (count)
IOOS (count)
COMT_Projects (count)
    </content>
  </entry>
  <entry>
    <title>IOOS Regional Association raw asset inventory since 2020-01-01.</title>
    <link href="https://erddap.ioos.us/erddap/tabledap/raw_asset_inventory.html"/>
    <id>https://erddap.ioos.us/erddap/tabledap/raw_asset_inventory.html</id>
    <updated>2026-11-23T16:41:24Z</updated>
    <content type="text">
The Observing Asset Inventory requirements can be found on the bottom of page 4 of the Cooperative Agreement Progress Report Guidance document. The inventories cover the entire calendar year (CY), for the year they are reporting (eg. for 2020 the period of time is Jan 1 2020 - Dec 31 2020).

cdm_data_type = Other
VARIABLES:
Year (Year of the inventory in YYYY format)
RA (Regional Association)
Station_ID (Station Identifier)
WMO_ID_or_NWS_CMAN_ID
Station_Long_Name
Station_Description
latitude (degrees_north)
longitude (degrees_east)
Platform_Type
Station_Deployment (Station Deployment (mm/yyyy, yyyy, < 5 yr, > 5 yr))
Currently_Operational (Currently Operational? (Y, N, O, U))
Platform_Funder (Platform Funder/Sponsor)
RA_Funded (RA Funding Involvement (Yf, Yp, N))
Platform_Operator (Platform Operator/Owner)
Operator_Sector
Platform_Maintainer
Data_Manager
Variable_Names (Variable Names + Water Column Depth Of Measurement In Meters [CF Name (# M, # M) Or CF Name (mult) Or CF Name (# Depths)].)
Additional_notes
file
crs (Coordinate reference system information)
    </content>
